display_mode.label: Display
display_mode.description: What the widget shows for the active layout.

scrolling_glyph.label: Scrolling Icon
scrolling_glyph.description: Glyph shown while the workspace uses the scrolling layout.

dwindle_glyph.label: Dwindle Icon
dwindle_glyph.description: Glyph shown while the workspace uses the dwindle layout.

scrolling_word.label: Scrolling Word
scrolling_word.description: Text for the scrolling layout. Empty uses the translated name.

dwindle_word.label: Dwindle Word
dwindle_word.description: Text for the dwindle layout. Empty uses the translated name.

scrolling_letter.label: Scrolling Letter
scrolling_letter.description: Short form for the scrolling layout. Empty uses the first character of the word.

dwindle_letter.label: Dwindle Letter
dwindle_letter.description: Short form for the dwindle layout. Empty uses the first character of the word.

color.label: Color
color.description: Color of the icon and the text.

glyph_size.label: Icon Size
glyph_size.description: Size of the layout icon, in logical pixels.

font_size.label: Text Size
font_size.description: Size of the letter or word, in logical pixels.

gap.label: Spacing
gap.description: Gap between the icon and the text when both are shown.

uppercase_letter.label: Uppercase Letter
uppercase_letter.description: Capitalise the letter derived from the word. Ignored when the letter is set explicitly.

show_tooltip.label: Show Tooltip
show_tooltip.description: Name the current layout, and the one a click switches to, on hover.

notify_on_toggle.label: Notify On Switch
notify_on_toggle.description: Send a notification naming the layout after each switch.

umbriel_config_path.label: Umbriel Config
umbriel_config_path.description: Config file to read the base layout and workspace rules from. Empty uses ~/.config/umbriel/config.toml.

fallback_mode.label: Fallback Layout
fallback_mode.description: Layout assumed when the workspace watcher is unavailable and umbriel's config cannot be read. Automatic uses [layout] mode from the config.

watch_command.label: Workspace Watch Command
watch_command.description: Command that prints '<output> <workspace>' whenever the active workspace changes. Empty uses umbriel-workspace-watch. Takes effect on reload.
